name: Flex Import
author: flextheme

sections.description:
Flex Import is a modern one-click demo importer plugin built to simplify and accelerate WordPress website creation. Whether you are building a business website, portfolio, agency website, ecommerce store, blog, or landing page, Flex Import helps you launch professional websites quickly using pre-designed starter templates and layouts.

The plugin is designed for Premium WordPress Themes and WordPress Theme Bundle, providing a smooth onboarding experience with automatic plugin installation, responsive templates, and easy demo imports directly from your WordPress dashboard.

With Flex Import, you can import complete website demos including pages, posts, widgets, menus, customizer settings, and theme options in just a few clicks — saving hours of manual setup time.

The plugin includes a clean and beginner-friendly dashboard where users can browse starter templates, manage imports, install required plugins, and access support resources.

⚡ Flex Import also gives users access to professionally designed WordPress Theme Bundle with multiple modern website designs for different industries and business types.

Key Features

One-Click Demo Import

Instantly import:

  • Pages
  • Posts
  • Images
  • Menus
  • Widgets
  • Theme Options
  • Customizer Settings

WordPress Theme Bundle

Access a growing collection of Premium WordPress Themes and complete WordPress Theme Bundle designed for:

  • Business Websites
  • Ecommerce Stores
  • Agency Websites
  • Blogs
  • Portfolio Websites
  • Landing Pages
  • Startup Websites
  • And many more starter website templates.

Automatic Plugin Installation

Flex Import automatically installs and activates all required and recommended plugins needed for starter templates.

Starter Templates Library

Access professionally designed templates for multiple industries and website categories.

Centralized Dashboard

Manage imports, templates, plugins, support, and theme bundle access from one clean WordPress dashboard.

Responsive Layouts

All starter templates are fully responsive and optimized for:

  • Desktop
  • Tablet
  • Mobile Devices

Elementor Compatible

Built to work smoothly with Elementor layouts.

Automatic Template Updates

Receive updated starter templates, layouts, and improvements regularly.

Beginner Friendly

Easy setup process designed for beginners, freelancers, agencies, and developers.

Lightweight & Optimized

Built with performance and modern WordPress standards in mind.

Multisite Compatible

Supports WordPress Multisite installations.

Why Choose Flex Import?

  • Save hours of website setup time
  • Launch professional websites quickly
  • Import complete demos instantly
  • Access Premium WordPress Themes
  • Explore complete WordPress Theme Bundles
  • User-friendly interface
  • Responsive and modern layouts
  • Compatible with modern WordPress themes
  • Fast and secure demo importing
  • Regular updates and improvements

External services

This plugin integrates with our server’s API to provide seamless JSON-based data communication. Additionally, it includes a demo import feature that fetches and writes pre-coded demo files directly to your WordPress installation for a smooth setup experience.

The server API and demo import are utilized to enhance the functionality of your WordPress site by automating data handling and demo content integration. All data interactions are secure and comply with standard best practices.

This service is provided by “Flextheme”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload via WordPress Admin
o Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
o Search for Flex Import and click Install Now.
o Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin.

2. Manual Upload
o Download the Flex Import plugin zip file from the WordPress.org repository.
o In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
o Choose the flex-import.zip file, click Install Now, and then Activate.

3. Using Flex Import
o Upon activation, you will be prompted to install the Flex Theme. If you haven’t installed it yet, follow the on-screen instructions.
o After theme installation, open the Flex Import Dashboard from your WordPress menu.
o Browse available templates, plugins, and widgets, and select the demo content you wish to import.
o Click Import Demo and let Flex Import handle the rest. Your site will be populated with demo content, settings, and required plugins within moments.
